title: Donation swap uses limitRaw=0 relying solely on a pooler-supplied minUSDC floor (no on-chain oracle/TWAP reference)
description: BalancerPoolerV2.sol:214-243 swaps with limitRaw=0 and only the pooler-provided minUSDC as slippage protection; there is no independent on-chain price reference (oracle/TWAP). A pooler passing minUSDC=0 is itself a role mistake.
impact: Bounded to the donation slice destined for the owner-configured batchMinter flow, not user deposits. pool() is onlyAuthorizedPooler + whenNotPaused + nonReentrant; minUSDC is supplied by that same semi-trusted pooler at call time.
attackPath: BalancerPoolerV2.sol:214-243 swaps with limitRaw=0 and only the pooler-provided minUSDC as slippage protection; no independent on-chain price reference. A pooler passing minUSDC=0 is itself a role mistake.
likelihood: low - requires a semi-trusted pooler to supply a weak/zero floor.
assumptions: Authorized pooler is semi-trusted per project trust model.
externalRequirements: Authorized-pooler action with a weak minUSDC; value at risk is the owner-configured donation flow.
recommendation: Add an independent on-chain price reference (oracle or TWAP) to derive or sanity-check the swap floor, and/or enforce a non-zero minimum on minUSDC so a pooler cannot pass an unprotected (zero) floor.
justification: Downgraded from Medium by sanitizer: protection is delegated to an off-chain-chosen floor supplied by a semi-trusted role, and the value at risk is an owner/role-governed donation slice rather than user funds. Residual concern (no on-chain TWAP reference) is real hardening -> Low.
